notes: part.rim(sk2) names the four pocket-opening edges (a pocket wall is named by the sketch side that swept it, and survives edits of the plate). Naming a wall writes the pocket as pull(sk2, -4) subtracted from the plate so the kernel can find the walls. The kernel rounds the edges it can and refuses the neighbouring ones in a sentence; the shown solid is the part without the refused rounds, so it is not the FreeCAD solid. See attempts[].
